state:
Goal `core-str-1-3`: 10 of the 13 members in `dossier-core-str-1-3` owe nothing. They are `Core\Str::after`, `before`, `at`, `contains`, `endsWith`, `countOf`, `compare`, `fold`, `chunk` and `codePoints`. Each has `about.md`, three examples with blessed `.out`, one attack, one bench with a `docs/perf/members.ndjson` record, and a Rust `#[test]` with its `covers:` marker in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs`'s `mod tests`. Their cards use the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. The other cards in the file still say "Answers …".

3 members still owe every proof: `format` (1 of 3 examples on disk, `docs/examples/core/Str/format/01-basics.nvs`), `fromCodePoint` and `fromCodePoints`. When all three owe nothing the goal is met: run `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-str-1-3` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-str-1-3` before writing `DONE`.

How to work a member: `bun nv proofs --id '<id>'` lists what it owes. `--bless <files>` writes the `.out` files, `--run --only '<id>'` runs the examples and the attack, and `--record-perf --only '<id>'` records the bench. Re-run `--record-perf` if the machine is busy and calibration fails. A Rust test reads an array result with `super::Elements::of(answer.array_ptr()…)` and a string result with `taken(…)`, as `chunk_counts_clusters_leaves_only_the_last_short_and_refuses_a_zero_size` does. An exception's text is `$error->message`, not `getMessage()`. A string-keyed array is `array<string>` checked with `Core\Arr::hasKey`, and `map<…>` does not exist.
